title: Chicken Shawarma
description: Oven-roasted Middle Eastern chicken, marinated with authentic spices.

method.instruction: In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, salt, paprika, cumin, cardamom, crushed red pepper, and cinnamon.
Add chicken to the marinade and stir to coat evenly. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour or up to 24 hours.
Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a rimmed baking sheet with parchment paper.
Arrange chicken on the prepared sheet and roast for 15 minutes, turning halfway, until cooked through.
Remove from oven and thinly slice the chicken. For seared edges, sauté slices in a skillet with juices for 5 minutes, avoiding overcrowding.
Serve over rice or in pita with pickles, tomatoes, lettuce, and garlic or tahini sauce.

notes.title: Acknowledgment
notes.content: Recipe inspired by traditional Middle Eastern shawarma techniques.
